metadata.title: The top coefficient of the Links-Gould invariant is Murasugi-sum multiplicative
metadata.abstract: We prove that the Laurent polynomial in $\mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]$ that is the top coefficient of the Links-Gould invariant of the boundary of a Seifert surface is multiplicative under arbitrary Murasugi sums of minimal genus Seifert surfaces. This extends a previous result of the second and third authors which only holds for plumbing, i.e. 4-Murasugi sum. Our technique relies on quantum supergroup themselves and PBW basis rather than the skein relations used in the previous work.
